changelog:
- Initial release of pixelvault-list.
- Lists recently uploaded images on PixelVault with their CDN URLs.
- Supports optional flags for JSON output and pagination (e.g., --json, --per-page).
- Requires the pixelvault CLI to be installed and configured.
summary: List recently uploaded images on PixelVault with their CDN URLs. Use when the user asks to "see my uploads", "find that image URL", "what images have I hoste...
